messages.translation: Open the official Rain Classroom answer page in-app (official submission logic preserved as-is)

messages.source:
将打开雨课堂官方作答页完成提交。

页面内是雨课堂官方提交逻辑（含其自身的截止/次数校验与二次确认），请在其中确认后提交；关闭或返回后本页会自动刷新真实状态。
messages.translation:
The official Rain Classroom answer page will open to complete the submission.

Inside that page is Rain Classroom's official submission logic (including its own deadline/attempt checks and confirmation). Please confirm and submit there; this page will automatically refresh the real status after you close or go back.

messages.source: 详情拉取失败不影响列表状态；可用右上角「浏览器打开」走官方页面（R20-A 通道）。
messages.translation: A detail fetch failure does not affect list status; use "Open in browser" at the top right to go through the official page (R20-A channel).
